主要内容: On January 21, 2015, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (the “Company”), R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (“RLD” and with the Company, collectively, “Borrower”), and Santander Bank, N.A. (“Santander”) entered into a Seventh Amendment to Revolving Credit, Term Loan and Security Agreement (the “Seventh Amendment”) to amend that certain Revolving Credit, Term Loan and Security Agreement dated August 6, 2008, as amended by the previous six amendments. The Seventh Amendment extended the Termination Date of the Loan Agreement from February 1, 2015 to February 1, 2016, continued the installment payments of principal under the Term Loan at the same monthly payment of $18,125 per month, increased the interest rates applicable to the Revolver and the Term Loan by one quarter of one percent (0.25%), and reset and modified the Minimum EBITDA covenant to address the term being extended by one year. The Company paid a $15,000 amendment fee to Santander in connection with the Seventh Amendment. The report discusses a financial amendment related to the Loan Agreement between Santander Bank, N.A. and Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. and R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC. The amendment, dated January 21, 2015, outlines the terms under which the obligations of the Company may be accelerated in the event of a default, including non-payment of principal or interest. The report also includes the Seventh Amendment to Revolving Credit, Term Loan and Security Agreement, which was filed as Exhibit 99.1. The document was signed by Eric Skolnik, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc., on January 21, 2015.
